text:
maria-finance: Quick heads-up — seeing a ~$12.15k difference in rebate accrual for CloudEdge reseller on the Mar invoice. Invoice refs: AWS-MKT-INV-2026-03-015, partner ledger id CE-202603. Uploaded a line-level CSV to the finance drive. Can someone triage? Looks like commit SKU usage didn't map to reseller tier.

tim-accounting: On it. Can you paste the drive link or attach? I can't open the drive from my phone right now.

maria-finance: Uploaded here: https://drive.redwood.internal/finance/CE-rebates-1923.csv :eyes: Sample lines for quick visibility: `SKU:commit-1000 | usage: 1,912 | tier: bronze` and `SKU:commit-5000 | usage: 320 | tier: gold` — but the CSV shows channel_account empty for many commit rows.

lena-partnerops: @maria-finance noted. Is this the same CloudEdge account that had the commit uplift last month? We rolled a mapping change on 2026-03-10 which might have missed legacy SKUs.

sahil-aws-partner: I think the marketplace export relies on `channel_account`. Our nightly exporter dropped that field for legacy commit SKUs older than 2025-12. I can run a join against our partner table and see how many records lost the mapping. Give me ~30m.

tim-accounting: If it's a mapping gap we'll need a retro adjustment. Please flag as 'requires-adjustment' so we can include it in the Apr accrual if after cutoff. Also include calculation and proof lines.

billing-bot: Auto-note: GL code 5402 flagged for manual review. Created ticket FIN-1923 in Jira: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/FIN-1923

sahil-aws-partner: Quick update — join found 1,024 usage units not mapped to reseller tier -> delta = USD 12,150. Ran a dry-run fix: `python tools/market_join.py --partner CE --month 2026-03 --fix --dry-run` — output attached in CSV.

maria-finance: Thanks Sahil. Tim/Lena — can we approve a retro adjustment for March? My ask: absorb the adjustment in Apr accrual (so partner payout changes are reflected there) and send a reconciliation note to CloudEdge. I'll need PO/backups for the ledger posting.

lena-partnerops: I agree, approve the retro. I'll draft the partner note and loop in legal for wording. @tim-accounting please confirm GL posting and final amount.

tim-accounting: Confirmed. Post to GL 5402, amount USD 12,150, cost center: channel-sales. We'll include it on the 2026-04 accrual run. FIN-1923 will contain the CSV evidence and the dry-run logs.

maria-finance: Perfect. I'll attach the signed note and close FIN-1923 once partner acknowledges. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
